cohort: The study included 7699 pregnant women in Beijing, China, divided into a pre-COVID-19 cohort (delivered May-November 2019) and a COVID-19 cohort (delivered January-July 2020).
finding: During the COVID-19 pandemic, there was an increased risk of premature rupture of membranes, foetal distress, and both insufficient or excessive gestational weight gain among pregnant women.
